# R36S Builds

## Local Windows build

Build the image on your own PC using [the Windows WSL 2 guide](../README.md#building-on-windows-with-wsl-2).
It covers Ubuntu setup and dependencies in WSL, building the RK3326 toolchain
and R36S image, and copying the resulting `.img` to Windows for flashing.
Output is saved locally under
`release/aarch64/R36S/`.

These development images are unstable and intended for testing.
